summary: Conveyor idler roller: a tube fixed on a shaft that turns in two 6204 bearings held in two side plates
assumptions: Shaft 260 long so it passes through both side plates.

subassemblies.name: Roller
subassemblies.description: The roller with its shaft, bearings and side plates.

parts.name: Roller shaft
parts.description: Steel shaft Ø20 x 260 with 6204 bearing journals at both ends.

parts.name: Roller tube
parts.description: Steel roller tube Ø50 x 200, end discs bored Ø20, fixed on the shaft.

parts.name: Side plate
parts.description: Steel side plate 100 x 120 x 15 with a Ø47 H7 bearing bore.

parts.name: Bearing 6204
parts.description: Deep-groove ball bearing 6204, one in each side plate.
